title: Unscripted: We Don't Understand Our History
abstract:
"We don't understand our history." That's Barry O'Reilly's claim, and he asked for Kevlin Henney to take it up with him.

Where the two of them go from there is up to them.

This is our unscripted stage. No slides, no script, and no idea where it ends up.
